body:
Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ 456650c1f27fb8d7053f390b3573d0e199346251

Verdict FINDINGS

- Low — `crates/app/tests/mcp_post_options.rs:208`: enum type refusals are unpinned. Replacing `opt_word`'s non-string error with `Ok(None)` leaves all four pins green. A compound call such as `{"threading":null,"skip_stops":true}` can then silently apply the valid field. Add null/non-string enum cases with another valid change, and assert refusal leaves options unchanged. This is a coverage gap; the current implementation correctly refuses these calls.

Validation on a clean local merge with upstream/main `d2350d6a`:
- All four named pins passed. Final restored run passed 4/4.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green, 72 app suites plus lib, 315s, zero failures.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: green.
- Mutations RED: follow requires setup; follow plus fields; empty patch; unknown setup; boolean type; threading value; end-units value; between-setups value; tool registration; implicit active routing; null booleans treated as omitted.
- Mutations GREEN: enum type (finding above); empty setup (redundant: the unknown-setup guard still refuses it).
- Temporary extra probe passed: malformed enum values alongside a valid setup change refuse atomically; null setup targets the document while an owned active setup stays unchanged. The enum-type mutation makes this probe RED. Probe removed and every mutation restored.
- AGENTS checks passed: source files under 400 lines; no added production unwrap/expect/panic; no golden changes; no snapshot PNG, PROCESS_VERSION, dependency, .github or scripts changes. Body has Changelog: and Fixes #1534.

No production defect or unsafe output demonstrated. No code pushed, labels changed or ready state set.

Fixed the enum type coverage finding. Added null, boolean, number, array, and object cases for threading, end_units, and between_setups. Each call includes a valid skip_stops change. The test checks refusal leaves document and setup options unchanged.

Pin: `post_options_refuses_enum_types_without_applying_valid_fields`.
Mutation check: replacing the non-string refusal in opt_word with Ok(None) makes the pin RED. Restoring it makes the pin GREEN.

Quick gate against upstream/main and camcraft-app clippy with all targets and denied warnings are GREEN.

New head: de22c42e7cdf877b41bc7d868d25042c935b8953.

Please re-review.

Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ de22c42e7cdf877b41bc7d868d25042c935b8953

Verdict CLEAN. No findings.

- Local merge of upstream/main succeeded. All 5 post-option pins passed.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: GREEN, 0 failed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: GREEN, 0 warnings.
- Mutations: follow without setup, follow with fields, missing fields, empty setup, unknown setup, boolean types, enum types, and invalid threading/end-units/between-setups values each compiled and failed a pin. Each restored run passed.
- Registration removal: RED (5/5). Implicit active-setup routing: RED (3/5). Both restored runs passed.
- Extra safety probe passed: explicit null setup targets the document while the active setup retains its own options. A mixed invalid patch preserves state and undo history.
- AGENTS checks passed: no added production unwrap/expect/panic; changed Rust files remain below 400 lines; no goldens or forbidden file changes. Body includes Changelog and Fixes.

Head rechecked before posting. No code changes retained or pushed.

<!-- pr-reviewer: de22c42e7cdf877b41bc7d868d25042c935b8953 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Checks:
- The tools use explicit document or setup targets. Each change uses one existing undoable command.
- Input checks occur before a change. The tests cover setup isolation, undo and redo, follow mode, partial changes, and named refusals.
- The new enum-type test addresses the earlier coverage finding. It checks that an invalid field cannot cause a valid field in the same call to change the document or setup.
- The process-change declaration, decision record, Changelog line, and issue link are present.

Local build and test results:
- The trial merge with upstream/main `703af8185f7cfc574050d0187502b4b42d6b67eb` was clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. App unit tests and 72 integration suites: 659 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored. Time: 290 seconds.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- Final restored run of `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test mcp_post_options`: PASS, 5 tests.

Safety checks:
- These tools can change posted G-code options. I ran three mutations locally. Each compiled and caused a test to fail (RED): route an omitted setup to the active setup; treat null booleans as omitted; treat non-string enum values as omitted.
- Each restored test passed (GREEN). All mutation changes were removed.
- No NC or CL goldens changed. There are no moved golden lines to check.
- No UI files changed. Screenshots are not required for this change.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: The GUI and release test tier were not run. No GitHub runner was used.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
